evidence.description: Candidate patch wraps data.encode("utf-8") in try/except UnicodeEncodeError, raising AccordError("invalid contract JSON").

limitations: No tools or execution available; verification is by static inspection of the supplied source and constraints only.

result.summary: The candidate correctly isolates the UTF-8 encoding step in a try/except UnicodeEncodeError block, converting raw unpaired surrogate strings into AccordError("invalid contract JSON") before the size check. This preserves the 65536-byte size
